title: An item whose goal names the test ceiling has its open choices asked before the start, and its brief says a gate added there is class ceiling
goal: planning asks every choice an item's goal leaves open as a gate before the start gate when the goal or touches name the test ceiling (its ids, headroom or seconds), and the worker's brief of such an item says that a gate it adds whose text names the test ceiling is class ceiling, which no agent session answers, so the work stops until the operator's terminal answers it (SP-qlpfcgs2: ST-iai37tjr's worker asked whether precheck always prints the headroom line; the gate was classed ceiling and the item was carried out of the sprint with its goal clause unmet)

run:
import sys, tempfile, json, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_base, bl_dispatch
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", d], check=True)
bl_base.load_settings(d)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir()), exist_ok=True)

item = {"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "headroom line", "status": "doing", "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": "precheck prints the test ceiling headroom in seconds", "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["_tools/bl_land.py"]}
open(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir(), "ST-aaaaaaaa.json"), "w").write(json.dumps(item))
bl = bl_base.Backlog(d)
bl_dispatch.rules_section = lambda bl, iid: ["x"]
t = bl_dispatch.compose_brief(bl, "ST-aaaaaaaa")
ok = "class ceiling" in t and "no agent session answers" in t
print("brief of a ceiling-naming item says a gate it adds is class ceiling:", ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Evidence: ST-iai37tjr gate g1 on branch work/ST-iai37tjr (tip 8bfcef20e), class ceiling matched 'test ceiling' in its question; bl_authority refuses any answer from an agent session. The class is never weakened, so the remedy is earlier asking, not a narrower classifier. Recurred in SP-wjp5qllo: ST-k3e4q43i's goal named the darwin ceiling; its worker's gate g1 offered 'raise the darwin seconds ceiling' as an option, was classed ceiling, and stopped the unattended sprint until the operator answered it from a terminal.
